annotations.title: Put a file in a drive or a workbook

description: Puts a file into a connected drive or a workbook's attachments. With `text`, writes that text as the file at `path` in a drive (/googledrive/<folders>/<name>), folders made, a file already there overwritten: how a markdown file is put in a drive, since the bash shell cannot write to one. With `file` (an image, video or other file the person attached in this chat) or `url` (a public http(s) link), this server fetches it and writes it at `path` (a drive, or /attachments/<workbook>/<name>), up to 25 MB, and answers the drive's file id. Otherwise, for a file too large to send inline: returns a link to PUT the file to; then call again with `upload_id` to file it.

file.description: A file the person attached in the chat, written at `path`. Up to 25 MB.

download_url.description: A temporary link to the file's bytes.

file_id.description: The chat's id for the file.

size.description: The file's size in bytes, when known: one over the limit is refused before uploading.

text.description: The file's whole content, as text.

upload_id.description: Once the file is PUT: the upload_id the link came with.

url.description: A public http(s) link to the file: this server fetches it and writes it at `path`. Up to 25 MB.

name: upload
title: Put a file in a drive or a workbook
